title: Cloud Run capacity lag
expected_root_cause: Cloud Run capacity limit delayed synthetic orders
mechanism: A bounded traffic surge reached the configured instance cap and increased pending request latency without an application error signature.
impact_summary: Synthetic order latency increased during a bounded traffic surge.
next_checks: Compare pending latency and instance count with the configured maximum.

action.title: Propose a temporary capacity adjustment
action.description: Prepare an approval request to adjust the synthetic service capacity limit.
action.expected_effect: Reduce pending request latency during the bounded surge.
verification_steps: Repeat the bounded load and compare pending latency.

expected_timeline.description: Request volume and pending latency rise.
Instance count reaches the configured cap.

evidence.title: Request surge reached the instance cap
evidence.summary: Request count and pending latency rose while instance count reached the synthetic maximum.

evidence.title: No deployment preceded the surge
evidence.summary: No image or configuration change occurred before the latency increase.

evidence.title: Capacity saturation pattern
evidence.summary: Prior synthetic incidents associate pending latency and a flat instance ceiling with capacity saturation.
